purpose: Qualify busy preflight refusal and explicit recovery after destination loss or Esc following a completed native write.
source: Controlled Codex-compatible subprocess with real MCP and an opaque native write; no subscription credentials.
destination: Installed Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M through the unmodified M3 task profile and corrected OpenAI-compatible adapter.

faults.busy: Start an independent dispatched local work stream after recording the handoff. Refuse handoff preflight while that request is active without consuming its record or preempting the owner. Explicitly cancel the owner, restart the session and use the original valid record to write B.
faults.loss: After successful B write, kill only the exact owned runtime child upon its first subsequent text delta. Require failed execution, settled intents, a consumed-record refusal and completed-B rewrite refusal. Restart the session, explicitly reconcile C and complete.
faults.interrupt: After successful B write, press Esc during its subsequent text stream. Require cancelled execution, preserved draft and effects, a consumed-record refusal and completed-B rewrite refusal. Restart the session, explicitly reconcile C and complete.

initial_partial_prompt_suffix: Then list the integers from 1 to 10000, one per line, without skipping any.
memory: Installed memory plugin and normal vault mounted readonly. Only memory_list(subject=harness); no writes.
artifacts: A.txt stage A newline and native.txt external native effect before handoff. Busy case writes B once on recovery. Loss/Esc cases write B once before fault and C once after fresh reconciliation. Exact per-stage successful write counts and original event evidence required. Operator review remains unresolved.
data_policy: Metadata only: boolean checks, event/error types, context byte counts/hashes, catalog/source hashes, timing, isolation and runtime identity. Temporary sessions containing memory are removed; no payload, generated prose, exception bodies, raw logs or screenshots exported.
scope: Controlled fault qualification, not a live subscription provider, model quality evaluation, latency distribution, multi-agent portability or daily-use certification. Busy case verifies the existing idle-session preflight rule, not cross-session GPU admission.
changes: Keep all six journeys, deadlines, prompts, artifacts and outcome gates unchanged.
Measure non-preemption from the background request outcome: active or completed is allowed; cancellation or failure is rejected. The old done() proxy could not distinguish completion from preemption.
Add metadata-only stage and failure-state diagnostics. The first normal-memory interruption case ended in TimeoutError before outcome grading; its phase and cause were not retained.
The v1 run remains failed (four of six journeys pass). This is a separate development run, not a regrade or held-out confirmation. No core or model profile changes.
